hypothesis: Total-return momentum mixes stock-specific strength with market exposure. Removing the estimated market contribution may improve same-date stock selection.
scope: Single-market-component adjustment; not a replication of Fama-French residual momentum. Retain the fitted intercept contribution rather than summing in-sample OLS residuals, which would mechanically sum to zero.
unique_change: Replace archived 12-1 return ranking with log(C[t-21]/C[t-252]) minus beta[t] times the sum of market log returns from t-251 through t-21 inclusive. Higher is stronger.
beta: OLS slope with intercept from the trailing 252 adjacent-market-session daily log return pairs, ending on signal day. Center stock and market returns over each stock's common valid observations; do not subtract the fitted intercept from the ranking score. At least 120 pairs and positive market variance are required; no clipping or optimization of beta.
market_factor: Daily arithmetic mean of all observed SH/SZ adjacent-session simple close returns, then log1p. Positive finite adjusted closes at both ends are required; abs(simple return)>0.5 excluded consistently with the existing market-return helper's data-quality bound. No latest constituents or future return weights.
opportunities: Exactly the archived 191688 eligible symbol/month events over 82 signal months. Preserve the 284837-row broad ledger, 40-session outcomes, fills/cash/censoring, costs and both reference returns. Do not rerun matching or condition ranks on fill status.
unavailable_score_action: Fail the experiment completeness check and retain the unscorable identities. Do not silently shrink the universe or default beta to zero.
groups: Same ten average-rank percentile bands as baseline; highest band selected; ties kept together; no percentile, window, holding or direction search.

statistics.weighting: equal signal months, equal allocations within group

reports: all scores, beta and common-observation counts
pass_action: Retain training support only; next validate fixed rebalancing portfolio, actual turnover/drawdown and historical execution/issuer facts before qualification.
fail_action: Stop this single-market-adjusted momentum representation and its beta-window, skip, percentile and holding variants. Return to a causally distinct selection mechanism; do not reverse the sign after seeing outcomes.
